definitions.explanation: A period of calm that occurs near the coast in the evening when the sea breeze dies down. By extension, a peaceful, still evening atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {夕凪|ゆうなぎ}の{時間|じかん}が{来|き}た。
examples.english: The time of evening calm has come.

examples.japanese: {夕凪|ゆうなぎ}の{海|うみ}は{鏡|かがみ}のように{静|しず}かだった。
examples.english: The sea during the evening calm was as still as a mirror.

examples.japanese: {瀬戸内海|せとないかい}の{夕凪|ゆうなぎ}は{夏|なつ}になると{特|とく}に{蒸|む}し{暑|あつ}くなる。
examples.english: The evening calm of the Seto Inland Sea becomes especially hot and humid in summer.

notes: A meteorological and literary term. {凪|なぎ} means a calm or lull in the wind, especially at sea. In coastal areas, the land-sea breeze cycle causes a brief period of stillness around sunset — this is {夕凪|ゆうなぎ}. The counterpart is {朝凪|あさなぎ} (morning calm). In the {瀬戸内海|せとないかい} (Seto Inland Sea) region, {夕凪|ゆうなぎ} is especially associated with oppressive summer heat because the wind stops completely.
